captions.detailed: A side-post cantilever monitor arm assembly consisting of a black vertical support pillar on a rectangular base, carrying a multi-segment gray articulated arm. The assembly features a dark collar on the post, a shoulder link, an elbowed forelink, and a rectangular mounting plate with pre-drilled holes. Each arm segment is connected via revolute joints, allowing the cantilever structure to pivot horizontally in a serial chain.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a side-post cantilever arm with a vertical black support post, a gray shoulder link, a gray forelink, and a rectangular mounting plate, utilizing serial revolute joints for horizontal pivoting.
captions.factory: Construct a base and vertical cylinder for the pillar using CadQuery primitives. Model the collar as an offset block, then build the shoulder and forelink segments as extruded profiles with rounded pivot bosses. Create the wrist mounting plate as a thin rectangular block with four circular hole cutouts, and define the serial revolute joints connecting each segment sequentially.
